title: Sweep LR warmdown length (WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5 -> 0.8)
description: Changed WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.8, giving a longer/gentler linear LR cooldown starting at progress=0.2 instead of 0.5, all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.005052, clearly worse than the 1.002279 baseline. A longer cooldown hurts here -- the model spends too much of the fixed 5-minute budget at reduced LR and gets less effective optimization done. This suggests the original WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.5 was already well-tuned; a shorter warmdown (e.g. 0.3) might be worth testing in a future round to check if the optimum is even earlier, but this direction (longer) is a clear miss.
